COPY INTO SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.USA_MEMBERS
(
    ID,
    NAME,
    TIERCODE,
    ENROLLMENTDATE,
    FLIGHTDATE,
    SOURCE_FILE,
    LOAD_TIMESTAMP
)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        METADATA$FILENAME,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    FROM @SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.STG_CSV
)
FILES = ('USA.csv')
FILE_FORMAT = (
    FORMAT_NAME = 'SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.FF_CSV'
)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';

COPY INTO SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.IND_MEMBERS
(
    ID,
    NAME,
    DOB,
    TIERCODE,
    ENROLLMENTDATE,
    INDIVIDUAL_OR_CORPORATE,
    FLIGHTDATE,
    SOURCE_FILE,
    LOAD_TIMESTAMP
)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        METADATA$FILENAME,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    FROM @SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.STG_CSV
)
FILES = ('IND.csv')
FILE_FORMAT = (
    FORMAT_NAME = 'SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.FF_CSV'
)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';

COPY INTO SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.AUS_MEMBERS
(
    UNIQUE_ID,
    MEMBER_NAME,
    TIER_TYPE,
    DATE_OF_BIRTH,
    DATE_OF_ENROLLMENT,
    DATE_OF_FLIGHT,
    SOURCE_FILE,
    LOAD_TIMESTAMP
)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        METADATA$FILENAME,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    FROM @SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.STG_CSV
)
FILES = ('AUS.csv')
FILE_FORMAT = (
    FORMAT_NAME = 'SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.FF_CSV'
)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';

COPY INTO SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.MEMBER_PROFILES_TXT
(
    RAW_LINE,
    SOURCE_FILE,
    LOAD_TIMESTAMP
)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        $1,
        METADATA$FILENAME,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    FROM @SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.STG_TXT
)
FILES = ('member_profiles_sample.txt')
FILE_FORMAT = (
    FORMAT_NAME = 'SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.FF_TXT'
)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';

COPY INTO SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.REDEMPTIONS_JSON
(
    RAW_DATA,
    SOURCE_FILE,
    LOAD_TIMESTAMP
)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        $1,
        METADATA$FILENAME,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    FROM @SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.STG_JSON
)
FILES = ('redemptions_sample.json')
FILE_FORMAT = (
    FORMAT_NAME = 'SKYPOINTS_DB.BRONZE.FF_JSON'
)
ON_ERROR = 'ABORT_STATEMENT';
